description: Fix CUDA OOM from DiT double-load, add model cache, fix custom node import failures (PromptServer mock, kornia compat), and update generate_chunk to avoid redundant model loads.
steps: Add _DIT_MODEL_CACHE global and cache logic to load_dit_model()
Add release_dit_model() function to clear cache and free memory
Modify _build_director_fallback() to accept optional dit_model and audio_vae parameters
Remove the DiT load from generate_chunk step 3 (let build_director_conditioning handle it)
Add PromptServer mock before import_custom_nodes() runs
Add kornia compatibility fix before import_custom_nodes() runs
acceptance_criteria: File parses without syntax errors (ast.parse succeeds)
load_dit_model() has a cache that prevents loading the model twice
release_dit_model() exists and clears the cache
_build_director_fallback() accepts optional dit_model/audio_vae params and reuses them
generate_chunk() does NOT call load_dit_model() directly before build_director_conditioning()
PromptServer mock is applied before import_custom_nodes()
kornia compatibility fix is applied before import_custom_nodes()
